name: tadween
description: Tadween social media automation: schedule, draft, and publish posts, manage connected channels, upload media, and track analytics across 28+ platforms including X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, and Telegram. Bundles the tadween skill and the hosted Tadween MCP server.

tadween.description: Official Tadween MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection: Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to Tadween; no token or local install required.
